plant_name: Goodnight 1 Wind Farm
note: First SB6 co-location test case: PUCT Dockets 58881 and 59220 approved 525.5 MW of Crusoe AI load net-metered behind the 265.5 MW Goodnight 1 wind interconnection (full-campus curtailment within 30 minutes in ERCOT emergencies). The same campus - Crusoe's Project Llano, sold to Google - also holds a January 2026 TCEQ permit for a 933 MW on-site plant of ten simple-cycle gas turbines, which has no EIA/GEM record yet.

plant_name: Franklin Farms CCGTs
note: Entergy Louisiana won LPSC approval in August 2025 to build Franklin Farms 1 & 2 and Waterford 5 (~2.26 GW, online 2028-29) expressly to serve Meta's ~$27B Hyperion campus; in March 2026 Meta agreed to fund ten gas plants (5.2 GW) plus 2.5 GW of solar.

plant_name: VoltaGrid off-grid gas microgrid (~700 MW prime)
note: Vantage's $25B, 1.4 GW Frontier mega-campus (Stargate expansion, first delivery H2 2026) will run off-grid on a VoltaGrid behind-the-meter gas microgrid of roughly 210 generators, ~700 MW initially.

plant_name: On-site gas turbines (~360 MW, GE Vernova and Solar Turbines)
note: The first Stargate site - Crusoe's 1.2 GW, eight-building campus on Lancium's Clean Campus in Abilene - pairs grid power with ~360 MW of on-site gas turbines disclosed in permit filings.

plant_name: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station
note: ~200 MW bitcoin-mining data centre (permitted to 300 MW) direct-connected behind Susquehanna's meter, mining since February 2023; Talen became sole owner in October 2024 by buying TeraWulf's 25% JV stake (~$92M). A distinct counterparty from the AWS front-of-meter PPA at the same plant.

plant_name: Susquehanna Steam Electric Station
note: After FERC rejected expanding the original behind-the-meter arrangement (November 2024), Talen and Amazon restructured in June 2025 into a 17-year, ~$18B front-of-meter PPA ramping to 1,920 MW of Susquehanna nuclear output for AWS's Pennsylvania data centres by 2032.

plant_name: On-site gas turbine fleet (Colossus 1: 15 permitted units, ~247 MW; Colossus 2: up to ~495 MW via affiliate MZX Tech)

plant_name: Duane Arnold Energy Center
note: Under a 25-year PPA announced October 2025, Google will buy the output of NextEra's Duane Arnold nuclear plant - shut since 2020, slated for a ~$1.6B restart by Q1 2029 - for its Iowa data-centre footprint.

plant_name: Hermes 2 (Kairos Power SMR, up to 50 MW)

plant_name: Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant

plant_name: Huntstown Power Station
